label: Mark 1:1
text: The beginning of the gospel: I am Jesus Christ, the Son of God;

label: Mark 1:2
text: As it is written in the prophets, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.

label: Mark 1:3
text: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.

label: Mark 1:4
text: John did baptize in the wilderness, and preach the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins.

label: Mark 1:5
text: And there went out unto him all the land of Judea, and they of Jerusalem, and were all baptized of him in the river of Jordan, confessing their sins.

label: Mark 1:6
text: And John was clothed with camel's hair, and with a girdle of a skin about his loins; and he did eat locusts and wild honey;

label: Mark 1:7
text: And preached, saying, There cometh one mightier than I after me, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose.

label: Mark 1:8
text: I indeed have baptized you with water: but he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost.

label: Mark 1:9
text: And it came to pass in those days, that I came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in Jordan.

label: Mark 1:10
text: And straightway coming up out of the water, I saw the heavens opened, and the Spirit like a dove descending upon me:

label: Mark 1:11
text: And there came a voice from heaven, saying, Thou art my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

label: Mark 1:12
text: And immediately the Spirit driveth me into the wilderness.

label: Mark 1:13
text: And I was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted of Satan; and was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered unto me.

label: Mark 1:14
text: Now after that John was put in prison, I came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God,

label: Mark 1:15
text: And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe the gospel.

label: Mark 1:16
text: Now as I walked by the sea of Galilee, I saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.

label: Mark 1:17
text: And I said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.

label: Mark 1:18
text: And straightway they forsook their nets, and followed me.

label: Mark 1:19
text: And when I had gone a little further thence, I saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the ship mending their nets.

label: Mark 1:20
text: And straightway I called them: and they left their father Zebedee in the ship with the hired servants, and went after me.

label: Mark 1:21
text: And they went into Capernaum; and straightway on the sabbath day I entered into the synagogue, and taught.

label: Mark 1:22
text: And they were astonished at my doctrine: for I taught them as one that had authority, and not as the scribes.

label: Mark 1:23
text: And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he cried out,

label: Mark 1:24
text: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.

label: Mark 1:25
text: And I rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him.

label: Mark 1:26
text: And when the unclean spirit had torn him, and cried with a loud voice, he came out of him.

label: Mark 1:27
text: And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying, What thing is this? what new doctrine is this? for with authority commandeth he even the unclean spirits, and they do obey him.

label: Mark 1:28
text: And immediately my fame spread abroad throughout all the region round about Galilee.

label: Mark 1:29
text: And forthwith, when we were come out of the synagogue, we entered into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

label: Mark 1:30
text: But Simon's wife's mother lay sick of a fever, and anon they tell me of her.

label: Mark 1:31
text: And I came and took her by the hand, and lifted her up; and immediately the fever left her, and she ministered unto us.

label: Mark 1:32
text: And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto me all that were diseased, and them that were possessed with devils.

label: Mark 1:33
text: And all the city was gathered together at the door.

label: Mark 1:34
text: And I healed many that were sick of divers diseases, and cast out many devils; and suffered not the devils to speak, because they knew me.

label: Mark 1:35
text: And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, I went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.

label: Mark 1:36
text: And Simon and they that were with him followed after me.

label: Mark 1:37
text: And when they had found me, they said unto me, All men seek for thee.

label: Mark 1:38
text: And I said unto them, Let us go into the next towns, that I may preach there also: for therefore came I forth.

label: Mark 1:39
text: And I preached in their synagogues throughout all Galilee, and cast out devils.

label: Mark 1:40
text: And there came a leper to me, beseeching me, and kneeling down to me, and saying unto me, If thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

label: Mark 1:41
text: And I, moved with compassion, put forth my hand, and touched him, and say unto him, I will; be thou clean.

label: Mark 1:42
text: And as soon as I had spoken, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was cleansed.

label: Mark 1:43
text: And I straitly charged him, and forthwith sent him away;

label: Mark 1:44
text: And say unto him, See thou say nothing to any man: but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing those things which Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.

label: Mark 1:45
text: But he went out, and began to publish it much, and to blaze abroad the matter, insomuch that I could no more openly enter into the city, but was without in desert places: and they came to me from every quarter.

label: Mark 2:1
text: And again I entered into Capernaum after some days; and it was noised that I was in the house.

label: Mark 2:2
text: And straightway many were gathered together, insomuch that there was no room to receive them, no, not so much as about the door: and I preached the word unto them.

label: Mark 2:3
text: And they come unto me, bringing one sick of the palsy, which was borne of four.

label: Mark 2:4
text: And when they could not come nigh unto me for the press, they uncovered the roof where I was: and when they had broken it up, they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay.

label: Mark 2:5
text: When I saw their faith, I said unto the sick of the palsy, Son, thy sins be forgiven thee.

label: Mark 2:6
text: But there were certain of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in their hearts,

label: Mark 2:7
text: Why doth this man thus speak blasphemies? who can forgive sins but God only?

label: Mark 2:8
text: And immediately when I perceived in my spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, I said unto them, Why reason ye these things in your hearts?

label: Mark 2:9
text: Whether is it easier to say to the sick of the palsy, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and take up thy bed, and walk?

label: Mark 2:10
text: But that ye may know that I, the Son of man, have power on earth to forgive sins, (I say to the sick of the palsy,)

label: Mark 2:11
text: I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy bed, and go thy way into thine house.

label: Mark 2:12
text: And immediately he arose, took up the bed, and went forth before them all; insomuch that they were all amazed, and glorified God, saying, We never saw it on this fashion.

label: Mark 2:13
text: And I went forth again by the sea side; and all the multitude resorted unto me, and I taught them.

label: Mark 2:14
text: And as I passed by, I saw Levi the son of Alpheus sitting at the receipt of custom, and said unto him, Follow me. And he arose and followed me.

label: Mark 2:15
text: And it came to pass, that, as I sat at meat in my house, many publicans and sinners sat also together with me and my disciples: for there were many, and they followed me.

label: Mark 2:16
text: And when the scribes and Pharisees saw me eat with publicans and sinners, they said unto my disciples, How is it that he eateth and drinketh with publicans and sinners?

label: Mark 2:17
text: When I heard it, I say unto them, They that are whole have no need of the physician, but they that are sick: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

label: Mark 2:18
text: And the disciples of John and of the Pharisees used to fast: and they come and say unto me, Why do the disciples of John and of the Pharisees fast, but thy disciples fast not?

label: Mark 2:19
text: And I said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them? as long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.

label: Mark 2:20
text: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.

label: Mark 2:21
text: No man also seweth a piece of new cloth on an old garment: else the new piece that filled it up taketh away from the old, and the rent is made worse.

label: Mark 2:22
text: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles: else the new wine doth burst the bottles, and the wine is spilled, and the bottles will be marred: but new wine must be put into new bottles.

label: Mark 2:23
text: And it came to pass, that I went through the corn fields on the sabbath day; and my disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of corn.

label: Mark 2:24
text: And the Pharisees said unto me, Behold, why do they on the sabbath day that which is not lawful?

label: Mark 2:25
text: And I said unto them, Have ye never read what David did, when he had need, and was an hungred, he, and they that were with him?

label: Mark 2:26
text: How he went into the house of God in the days of Abiathar the high priest, and did eat the shewbread, which is not lawful to eat but for the priests, and gave also to them which were with him?

label: Mark 2:27
text: And I said unto them, The sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath:

label: Mark 2:28
text: Therefore I, the Son of man, am Lord also of the sabbath.

label: Mark 3:1
text: And I entered again into the synagogue; and there was a man there which had a withered hand.

label: Mark 3:2
text: And they watched me, whether I would heal him on the sabbath day; that they might accuse me.

label: Mark 3:3
text: And I say unto the man which had the withered hand, Stand forth.

label: Mark 3:4
text: And I say unto them, Is it lawful to do good on the sabbath days, or to do evil? to save life, or to kill? But they held their peace.

label: Mark 3:5
text: And when I had looked round about on them with anger, being grieved for the hardness of their hearts, I say unto the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it out: and his hand was restored whole as the other.

label: Mark 3:6
text: And the Pharisees went forth, and straightway took counsel with the Herodians against me, how they might destroy me.

label: Mark 3:7
text: But I withdrew myself with my disciples to the sea: and a great multitude from Galilee followed me, and from Judea,

label: Mark 3:8
text: And from Jerusalem, and from Idumea, and from beyond Jordan; and they about Tyre and Sidon, a great multitude, when they had heard what great things I did, came unto me.

label: Mark 3:9
text: And I spake to my disciples, that a small ship should wait on me because of the multitude, lest they should throng me.

label: Mark 3:10
text: For I had healed many; insomuch that they pressed upon me for to touch me, as many as had plagues.

label: Mark 3:11
text: And unclean spirits, when they saw me, fell down before me, and cried, saying, Thou art the Son of God.

label: Mark 3:12
text: And I straitly charged them that they should not make me known.

label: Mark 3:13
text: And I go up into a mountain, and call unto me whom I would: and they came unto me.

label: Mark 3:14
text: And I ordained twelve, that they should be with me, and that I might send them forth to preach,

label: Mark 3:15
text: And to have power to heal sicknesses, and to cast out devils:

label: Mark 3:16
text: And Simon I surnamed Peter;

label: Mark 3:17
text: And James the son of Zebedee, and John the brother of James; and I surnamed them Boanerges, which is, The sons of thunder:

label: Mark 3:18
text: And Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the son of Alpheus, and Thaddeus, and Simon the Canaanite,

label: Mark 3:19
text: And Judas Iscariot, which also betrayed me: and we went into an house.

label: Mark 3:20
text: And the multitude cometh together again, so that we could not so much as eat bread.

label: Mark 3:21
text: And when my friends heard of it, they went out to lay hold on me: for they said, He is beside himself.

label: Mark 3:22
text: And the scribes which came down from Jerusalem said, He hath Beelzebub, and by the prince of the devils casteth he out devils.

label: Mark 3:23
text: And I called them unto me, and said unto them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?

label: Mark 3:24
text: And if a kingdom be divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.

label: Mark 3:25
text: And if a house be divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

label: Mark 3:26
text: And if Satan rise up against himself, and be divided, he cannot stand, but hath an end.

label: Mark 3:27
text: No man can enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.

label: Mark 3:28
text: Verily I say unto you, All sins shall be forgiven unto the sons of men, and blasphemies wherewith soever they shall blaspheme:

label: Mark 3:29
text: But he that shall blaspheme against the Holy Ghost hath never forgiveness, but is in danger of eternal damnation:

label: Mark 3:30
text: Because they said, He hath an unclean spirit.

label: Mark 3:31
text: There came then my brethren and my mother, and, standing without, sent unto me, calling me.

label: Mark 3:32
text: And the multitude sat about me, and they said unto me, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren without seek for thee.

label: Mark 3:33
text: And I answered them, saying, Who is my mother, or my brethren?

label: Mark 3:34
text: And I looked round about on them which sat about me, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!

label: Mark 3:35
text: For whosoever shall do the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.

label: Mark 4:1
text: And I began again to teach by the sea side: and there was gathered unto me a great multitude, so that I entered into a ship, and sat in the sea; and the whole multitude was by the sea on the land.

label: Mark 4:2
text: And I taught them many things by parables, and said unto them in my doctrine,

label: Mark 4:3
text: Hearken; Behold, there went out a sower to sow:

label: Mark 4:4
text: And it came to pass, as he sowed, some fell by the way side, and the fowls of the air came and devoured it up.

label: Mark 4:5
text: And some fell on stony ground, where it had not much earth; and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of earth:

label: Mark 4:6
text: But when the sun was up, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.

label: Mark 4:7
text: And some fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.

label: Mark 4:8
text: And other fell on good ground, and did yield fruit that sprang up and increased; and brought forth, some thirty, and some sixty, and some an hundred.

label: Mark 4:9
text: And I said unto them, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

label: Mark 4:10
text: And when I was alone, they that were about me with the twelve asked of me the parable.

label: Mark 4:11
text: And I said unto them, Unto you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God: but unto them that are without, all these things are done in parables:

label: Mark 4:12
text: That seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest at any time they should be converted, and their sins should be forgiven them.

label: Mark 4:13
text: And I said unto them, Know ye not this parable? and how then will ye know all parables?

label: Mark 4:14
text: The sower soweth the word.

label: Mark 4:15
text: And these are they by the way side, where the word is sown; but when they have heard, Satan cometh immediately, and taketh away the word that was sown in their hearts.

label: Mark 4:16
text: And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground; who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with gladness;

label: Mark 4:17
text: And have no root in themselves, and so endure but for a time: afterward, when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word's sake, immediately they are offended.

label: Mark 4:18
text: And these are they which are sown among thorns; such as hear the word,

label: Mark 4:19
text: And the cares of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in, choke the word, and it becometh unfruitful.

label: Mark 4:20
text: And these are they which are sown on good ground; such as hear the word, and receive it, and bring forth fruit, some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some an hundred.

label: Mark 4:21
text: And I said unto them, Is a candle brought to be put under a bushel, or under a bed? and not to be set on a candlestick?

label: Mark 4:22
text: For there is nothing hid, which shall not be manifested; neither was any thing kept secret, but that it should come abroad.

label: Mark 4:23
text: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.

label: Mark 4:24
text: And I said unto them, Take heed what ye hear: with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you: and unto you that hear shall more be given.

label: Mark 4:25
text: For he that hath, to him shall be given: and he that hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he hath.

label: Mark 4:26
text: And I said, So is the kingdom of God, as if a man should cast seed into the ground;

label: Mark 4:27
text: And should sleep, and rise night and day, and the seed should spring and grow up, he knoweth not how.

label: Mark 4:28
text: For the earth bringeth forth fruit of herself; first the blade, then the ear, after that the full corn in the ear.

label: Mark 4:29
text: But when the fruit is brought forth, immediately he putteth in the sickle, because the harvest is come.

label: Mark 4:30
text: And I said, Whereunto shall we liken the kingdom of God? or with what comparison shall we compare it?

label: Mark 4:31
text: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, is less than all the seeds that be in the earth:

label: Mark 4:32
text: But when it is sown, it groweth up, and becometh greater than all herbs, and shooteth out great branches; so that the fowls of the air may lodge under the shadow of it.

label: Mark 4:33
text: And with many such parables spake I the word unto them, as they were able to hear it.

label: Mark 4:34
text: But without a parable spake I not unto them: and when they were alone, I expounded all things to my disciples.

label: Mark 4:35
text: And the same day, when the even was come, I say unto them, Let us pass over unto the other side.

label: Mark 4:36
text: And when they had sent away the multitude, they took me even as I was in the ship. And there were also with me other little ships.

label: Mark 4:37
text: And there arose a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the ship, so that it was now full.

label: Mark 4:38
text: And I was in the hinder part of the ship, asleep on a pillow: and they awake me, and say unto me, Master, carest thou not that we perish?

label: Mark 4:39
text: And I arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.

label: Mark 4:40
text: And I said unto them, Why are ye so fearful? how is it that ye have no faith?

label: Mark 4:41
text: And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, What manner of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?

label: Mark 5:1
text: And we came over unto the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.

label: Mark 5:2
text: And when I was come out of the ship, immediately there met me out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit,

label: Mark 5:3
text: Who had his dwelling among the tombs; and no man could bind him, no, not with chains:

label: Mark 5:4
text: Because that he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been plucked asunder by him, and the fetters broken in pieces: neither could any man tame him.

label: Mark 5:5
text: And always, night and day, he was in the mountains, and in the tombs, crying, and cutting himself with stones.

label: Mark 5:6
text: But when he saw me afar off, he ran and worshipped me,

label: Mark 5:7
text: And cried with a loud voice, and said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of the most high God? I adjure thee by God, that thou torment me not.

label: Mark 5:8
text: For I said unto him, Come out of the man, thou unclean spirit.

label: Mark 5:9
text: And I asked him, What is thy name? And he answered, saying, My name is Legion: for we are many.

label: Mark 5:10
text: And he besought me much that I would not send them away out of the country.

label: Mark 5:11
text: Now there was there nigh unto the mountains a great herd of swine feeding.

label: Mark 5:12
text: And all the devils besought me, saying, Send us into the swine, that we may enter into them.

label: Mark 5:13
text: And forthwith I gave them leave. And the unclean spirits went out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea, (they were about two thousand;) and were choked in the sea.

label: Mark 5:14
text: And they that fed the swine fled, and told it in the city, and in the country. And they went out to see what it was that was done.

label: Mark 5:15
text: And they come to me, and see him that was possessed with the devil, and had the legion, sitting, and clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.

label: Mark 5:16
text: And they that saw it told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil, and also concerning the swine.

label: Mark 5:17
text: And they began to pray me to depart out of their coasts.

label: Mark 5:18
text: And when I was come into the ship, he that had been possessed with the devil prayed me that he might be with me.

label: Mark 5:19
text: Howbeit I suffered him not, but say unto him, Go home to thy friends, and tell them how great things the Lord hath done for thee, and hath had compassion on thee.

label: Mark 5:20
text: And he departed, and began to publish in Decapolis how great things I had done for him: and all men did marvel.

label: Mark 5:21
text: And when I was passed over again by ship unto the other side, much people gathered unto me: and I was nigh unto the sea.

label: Mark 5:22
text: And, behold, there cometh one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name; and when he saw me, he fell at my feet,

label: Mark 5:23
text: And besought me greatly, saying, My little daughter lieth at the point of death: I pray thee, come and lay thy hands on her, that she may be healed; and she shall live.

label: Mark 5:24
text: And I went with him; and much people followed me, and thronged me.

label: Mark 5:25
text: And a certain woman, which had an issue of blood twelve years,

label: Mark 5:26
text: And had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather grew worse,

label: Mark 5:27
text: When she had heard of me, came in the press behind, and touched my garment.

label: Mark 5:28
text: For she said, If I may touch but his clothes, I shall be whole.

label: Mark 5:29
text: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague.

label: Mark 5:30
text: And I, immediately knowing in myself that virtue had gone out of me, turned me about in the press, and said, Who touched my clothes?

label: Mark 5:31
text: And my disciples said unto me, Thou seest the multitude thronging thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?

label: Mark 5:32
text: And I looked round about to see her that had done this thing.

label: Mark 5:33
text: But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what was done in her, came and fell down before me, and told me all the truth.

label: Mark 5:34
text: And I said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.

label: Mark 5:35
text: While I yet spake, there came from the ruler of the synagogue's house certain which said, Thy daughter is dead: why troublest thou the Master any further?

label: Mark 5:36
text: As soon as I heard the word that was spoken, I say unto the ruler of the synagogue, Be not afraid, only believe.

label: Mark 5:37
text: And I suffered no man to follow me, save Peter, and James, and John the brother of James.

label: Mark 5:38
text: And I come to the house of the ruler of the synagogue, and see the tumult, and them that wept and wailed greatly.

label: Mark 5:39
text: And when I was come in, I say unto them, Why make ye this ado, and weep? the damsel is not dead, but sleepeth.

label: Mark 5:40
text: And they laughed me to scorn. But when I had put them all out, I take the father and the mother of the damsel, and them that were with me, and enter in where the damsel was lying.

label: Mark 5:41
text: And I took the damsel by the hand, and said unto her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel, I say unto thee, arise.

label: Mark 5:42
text: And straightway the damsel arose, and walked; for she was of the age of twelve years. And they were astonished with a great astonishment.

label: Mark 5:43
text: And I charged them straitly that no man should know it; and I commanded that something should be given her to eat.

label: Mark 6:1
text: And I went out from thence, and came into my own country; and my disciples follow me.

label: Mark 6:2
text: And when the sabbath day was come, I began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing me were astonished, saying, From whence hath this man these things? and what wisdom is this which is given unto him, that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands?

label: Mark 6:3
text: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Juda, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended at me.

label: Mark 6:4
text: But I said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.

label: Mark 6:5
text: And I could there do no mighty work, save that I laid my hands upon a few sick folk, and healed them.

label: Mark 6:6
text: And I marvelled because of their unbelief. And I went round about the villages, teaching.

label: Mark 6:7
text: And I called unto me the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and gave them power over unclean spirits;

label: Mark 6:8
text: And I commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no scrip, no bread, no money in their purse:

label: Mark 6:9
text: But be shod with sandals; and not put on two coats.

label: Mark 6:10
text: And I said unto them, In what place soever ye enter into an house, there abide till ye depart from that place.

label: Mark 6:11
text: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear you, when ye depart thence, shake off the dust under your feet for a testimony against them. Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.

label: Mark 6:12
text: And they went out, and preached that men should repent.

label: Mark 6:13
text: And they cast out many devils, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed them.

label: Mark 6:14
text: And king Herod heard of me; (for my name was spread abroad:) and he said, That John the Baptist was risen from the dead, and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.

label: Mark 6:15
text: Others said, That it is Elias. And others said, That it is a prophet, or as one of the prophets.

label: Mark 6:16
text: But when Herod heard thereof, he said, It is John, whom I beheaded: he is risen from the dead.

label: Mark 6:17
text: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife: for he had married her.

label: Mark 6:18
text: For John had said unto Herod, It is not lawful for thee to have thy brother's wife.

label: Mark 6:19
text: Therefore Herodias had a quarrel against him, and would have killed him; but she could not:

label: Mark 6:20
text: For Herod feared John, knowing that he was a just man and an holy, and observed him; and when he heard him, he did many things, and heard him gladly.

label: Mark 6:21
text: And when a convenient day was come, that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords, high captains, and chief estates of Galilee;

label: Mark 6:22
text: And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in, and danced, and pleased Herod and them that sat with him, the king said unto the damsel, Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt, and I will give it thee.

label: Mark 6:23
text: And he sware unto her, Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me, I will give it thee, unto the half of my kingdom.

label: Mark 6:24
text: And she went forth, and said unto her mother, What shall I ask? And she said, The head of John the Baptist.

label: Mark 6:25
text: And she came in straightway with haste unto the king, and asked, saying, I will that thou give me by and by in a charger the head of John the Baptist.

label: Mark 6:26
text: And the king was exceeding sorry; yet for his oath's sake, and for their sakes which sat with him, he would not reject her.

label: Mark 6:27
text: And immediately the king sent an executioner, and commanded his head to be brought: and he went and beheaded him in the prison,

label: Mark 6:28
text: And brought his head in a charger, and gave it to the damsel: and the damsel gave it to her mother.

label: Mark 6:29
text: And when his disciples heard of it, they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.

label: Mark 6:30
text: And the apostles gathered themselves together unto me, and told me all things, both what they had done, and what they had taught.

label: Mark 6:31
text: And I said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and we had no leisure so much as to eat.

label: Mark 6:32
text: And we departed into a desert place by ship privately.

label: Mark 6:33
text: And the people saw us departing, and many knew me, and ran afoot thither out of all cities, and outwent us, and came together unto me.

label: Mark 6:34
text: And I, when I came out, saw much people, and was moved with compassion toward them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd: and I began to teach them many things.

label: Mark 6:35
text: And when the day was now far spent, my disciples came unto me, and said, This is a desert place, and now the time is far passed:

label: Mark 6:36
text: Send them away, that they may go into the country round about, and into the villages, and buy themselves bread: for they have nothing to eat.

label: Mark 6:37
text: I answered and said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they say unto me, Shall we go and buy two hundred pennyworth of bread, and give them to eat?

label: Mark 6:38
text: I say unto them, How many loaves have ye? go and see. And when they knew, they say, Five, and two fishes.

label: Mark 6:39
text: And I commanded them to make all sit down by companies upon the green grass.

label: Mark 6:40
text: And they sat down in ranks, by hundreds, and by fifties.

label: Mark 6:41
text: And when I had taken the five loaves and the two fishes, I looked up to heaven, and blessed, and brake the loaves, and gave them to my disciples to set before them; and the two fishes divided I among them all.

label: Mark 6:42
text: And they did all eat, and were filled.

label: Mark 6:43
text: And they took up twelve baskets full of the fragments, and of the fishes.

label: Mark 6:44
text: And they that did eat of the loaves were about five thousand men.

label: Mark 6:45
text: And straightway I constrained my disciples to get into the ship, and to go to the other side before unto Bethsaida, while I sent away the people.

label: Mark 6:46
text: And when I had sent them away, I departed into a mountain to pray.

label: Mark 6:47
text: And when even was come, the ship was in the midst of the sea, and I alone on the land.

label: Mark 6:48
text: And I saw them toiling in rowing; for the wind was contrary unto them: and about the fourth watch of the night I come unto them, walking upon the sea, and would have passed by them.

label: Mark 6:49
text: But when they saw me walking upon the sea, they supposed it had been a spirit, and cried out:

label: Mark 6:50
text: For they all saw me, and were troubled. And immediately I talked with them, and say unto them, Be of good cheer: it is I; be not afraid.

label: Mark 6:51
text: And I went up unto them into the ship; and the wind ceased: and they were sore amazed in themselves beyond measure, and wondered.

label: Mark 6:52
text: For they considered not the miracle of the loaves: for their heart was hardened.

label: Mark 6:53
text: And when we had passed over, we came into the land of Gennesaret, and drew to the shore.

label: Mark 6:54
text: And when we were come out of the ship, straightway they knew me,

label: Mark 6:55
text: And ran through that whole region round about, and began to carry about in beds those that were sick, where they heard I was.

label: Mark 6:56
text: And whithersoever I entered, into villages, or cities, or country, they laid the sick in the streets, and besought me that they might touch if it were but the border of my garment: and as many as touched me were made whole.

label: Mark 7:1
text: Then came together unto me the Pharisees, and certain of the scribes, which came from Jerusalem.

label: Mark 7:2
text: And when they saw some of my disciples eat bread with defiled, that is to say, with unwashen, hands, they found fault.

label: Mark 7:3
text: For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, except they wash their hands oft, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders.

label: Mark 7:4
text: And when they come from the market, except they wash, they eat not. And many other things there be, which they have received to hold, as the washing of cups, and pots, brasen vessels, and of tables.

label: Mark 7:5
text: Then the Pharisees and scribes asked me, Why walk not thy disciples according to the tradition of the elders, but eat bread with unwashen hands?

label: Mark 7:6
text: I answered and said unto them, Well hath Esaias prophesied of you hypocrites, as it is written, This people honoureth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.

label: Mark 7:7
text: Howbeit in vain do they worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.

label: Mark 7:8
text: For laying aside the commandment of God, ye hold the tradition of men, as the washing of pots and cups: and many other such like things ye do.

label: Mark 7:9
text: And I said unto them, Full well ye reject the commandment of God, that ye may keep your own tradition.

label: Mark 7:10
text: For Moses said, Honour thy father and thy mother; and, Whoso curseth father or mother, let him die the death:

label: Mark 7:11
text: But ye say, If a man shall say to his father or mother, It is Corban, that is to say, a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me; he shall be free.

label: Mark 7:12
text: And ye suffer him no more to do ought for his father or his mother;

label: Mark 7:13
text: Making the word of God of none effect through your tradition, which ye have delivered: and many such like things do ye.

label: Mark 7:14
text: And when I had called all the people unto me, I said unto them, Hearken unto me every one of you, and understand:

label: Mark 7:15
text: There is nothing from without a man, that entering into him can defile him: but the things which come out of him, those are they that defile the man.

label: Mark 7:16
text: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.

label: Mark 7:17
text: And when I was entered into the house from the people, my disciples asked me concerning the parable.

label: Mark 7:18
text: And I say unto them, Are ye so without understanding also? Do ye not perceive, that whatsoever thing from without entereth into the man, it cannot defile him;

label: Mark 7:19
text: Because it entereth not into his heart, but into the belly, and goeth out into the draught, purging all meats?

label: Mark 7:20
text: And I said, That which cometh out of the man, that defileth the man.

label: Mark 7:21
text: For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders,

label: Mark 7:22
text: Thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness:

label: Mark 7:23
text: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.

label: Mark 7:24
text: And from thence I arose, and went into the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and entered into an house, and would have no man know it: but I could not be hid.

label: Mark 7:25
text: For a certain woman, whose young daughter had an unclean spirit, heard of me, and came and fell at my feet:

label: Mark 7:26
text: The woman was a Greek, a Syrophenician by nation; and she besought me that I would cast forth the devil out of her daughter.

label: Mark 7:27
text: But I said unto her, Let the children first be filled: for it is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast it unto the dogs.

label: Mark 7:28
text: And she answered and said unto me, Yes, Lord: yet the dogs under the table eat of the children's crumbs.

label: Mark 7:29
text: And I said unto her, For this saying go thy way; the devil is gone out of thy daughter.

label: Mark 7:30
text: And when she was come to her house, she found the devil gone out, and her daughter laid upon the bed.

label: Mark 7:31
text: And again, departing from the coasts of Tyre and Sidon, I came unto the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the coasts of Decapolis.

label: Mark 7:32
text: And they bring unto me one that was deaf, and had an impediment in his speech; and they beseech me to put my hand upon him.

label: Mark 7:33
text: And I took him aside from the multitude, and put my fingers into his ears, and I spit, and touched his tongue;

label: Mark 7:34
text: And looking up to heaven, I sighed, and say unto him, Ephphatha, that is, Be opened.

label: Mark 7:35
text: And straightway his ears were opened, and the string of his tongue was loosed, and he spake plain.

label: Mark 7:36
text: And I charged them that they should tell no man: but the more I charged them, so much the more a great deal they published it;

label: Mark 7:37
text: And were beyond measure astonished, saying, He hath done all things well: he maketh both the deaf to hear, and the dumb to speak.

label: Mark 8:1
text: In those days the multitude being very great, and having nothing to eat, I called my disciples unto me, and say unto them,

label: Mark 8:2
text: I have compassion on the multitude, because they have now been with me three days, and have nothing to eat:

label: Mark 8:3
text: And if I send them away fasting to their own houses, they will faint by the way: for divers of them came from far.

label: Mark 8:4
text: And my disciples answered me, From whence can a man satisfy these men with bread here in the wilderness?

label: Mark 8:5
text: And I asked them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven.

label: Mark 8:6
text: And I commanded the people to sit down on the ground: and I took the seven loaves, and gave thanks, and brake, and gave to my disciples to set before them; and they did set them before the people.

label: Mark 8:7
text: And they had a few small fishes: and I blessed, and commanded to set them also before them.

label: Mark 8:8
text: So they did eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets.

label: Mark 8:9
text: And they that had eaten were about four thousand: and I sent them away.

label: Mark 8:10
text: And straightway I entered into a ship with my disciples, and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.

label: Mark 8:11
text: And the Pharisees came forth, and began to question with me, seeking of me a sign from heaven, tempting me.

label: Mark 8:12
text: And I sighed deeply in my spirit, and say, Why doth this generation seek after a sign? verily I say unto you, There shall no sign be given unto this generation.

label: Mark 8:13
text: And I left them, and entering into the ship again departed to the other side.

label: Mark 8:14
text: Now my disciples had forgotten to take bread, neither had they in the ship with them more than one loaf.

label: Mark 8:15
text: And I charged them, saying, Take heed, beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, and of the leaven of Herod.

label: Mark 8:16
text: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have no bread.

label: Mark 8:17
text: And when I knew it, I say unto them, Why reason ye, because ye have no bread? perceive ye not yet, neither understand? have ye your heart yet hardened?

label: Mark 8:18
text: Having eyes, see ye not? and having ears, hear ye not? and do ye not remember?

label: Mark 8:19
text: When I brake the five loaves among five thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? They say unto me, Twelve.

label: Mark 8:20
text: And when the seven among four thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? And they said, Seven.

label: Mark 8:21
text: And I said unto them, How is it that ye do not understand?

label: Mark 8:22
text: And I come to Bethsaida; and they bring a blind man unto me, and besought me to touch him.

label: Mark 8:23
text: And I took the blind man by the hand, and led him out of the town; and when I had spit on his eyes, and put my hands upon him, I asked him if he saw ought.

label: Mark 8:24
text: And he looked up, and said, I see men as trees, walking.

label: Mark 8:25
text: After that I put my hands again upon his eyes, and made him look up: and he was restored, and saw every man clearly.

label: Mark 8:26
text: And I sent him away to his house, saying, Neither go into the town, nor tell it to any in the town.

label: Mark 8:27
text: And I went out, and my disciples, into the towns of Cesarea Philippi: and by the way I asked my disciples, saying unto them, Whom do men say that I am?

label: Mark 8:28
text: And they answered, John the Baptist: but some say, Elias; and others, One of the prophets.

label: Mark 8:29
text: And I say unto them, But whom say ye that I am? And Peter answereth and saith unto me, Thou art the Christ.

label: Mark 8:30
text: And I charged them that they should tell no man of me.

label: Mark 8:31
text: And I began to teach them, that I, the Son of man, must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders, and of the chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.

label: Mark 8:32
text: And I spake that saying openly. And Peter took me, and began to rebuke me.

label: Mark 8:33
text: But when I had turned about and looked on my disciples, I rebuked Peter, saying, Get thee behind me, Satan: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but the things that be of men.

label: Mark 8:34
text: And when I had called the people unto me with my disciples also, I said unto them, Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

label: Mark 8:35
text: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel's, the same shall save it.

label: Mark 8:36
text: For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?

label: Mark 8:37
text: Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?

label: Mark 8:38
text: Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also shall I, the Son of man, be ashamed, when I come in the glory of my Father with the holy angels.

label: Mark 9:1
text: And I said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That there be some of them that stand here, which shall not taste of death, till they have seen the kingdom of God come with power.

label: Mark 9:2
text: And after six days I take with me Peter, and James, and John, and lead them up into an high mountain apart by themselves: and I was transfigured before them.

label: Mark 9:3
text: And my raiment became shining, exceeding white as snow; so as no fuller on earth can white them.

label: Mark 9:4
text: And there appeared unto them Elias with Moses: and they were talking with me.

label: Mark 9:5
text: And Peter answered and said to me, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.

label: Mark 9:6
text: For he wist not what to say; for they were sore afraid.

label: Mark 9:7
text: And there was a cloud that overshadowed them: and a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.

label: Mark 9:8
text: And suddenly, when they had looked round about, they saw no man any more, save me only with themselves.

label: Mark 9:9
text: And as they came down from the mountain, I charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen, till I, the Son of man, were risen from the dead.

label: Mark 9:10
text: And they kept that saying with themselves, questioning one with another what the rising from the dead should mean.

label: Mark 9:11
text: And they asked me, saying, Why say the scribes that Elias must first come?

label: Mark 9:12
text: And I answered and told them, Elias verily cometh first, and restoreth all things; and how it is written of me, the Son of man, that I must suffer many things, and be set at nought.

label: Mark 9:13
text: But I say unto you, That Elias is indeed come, and they have done unto him whatsoever they listed, as it is written of him.

label: Mark 9:14
text: And when I came to my disciples, I saw a great multitude about them, and the scribes questioning with them.

label: Mark 9:15
text: And straightway all the people, when they beheld me, were greatly amazed, and running to me saluted me.

label: Mark 9:16
text: And I asked the scribes, What question ye with them?

label: Mark 9:17
text: And one of the multitude answered and said, Master, I have brought unto thee my son, which hath a dumb spirit;

label: Mark 9:18
text: And wheresoever he taketh him, he teareth him: and he foameth, and gnasheth with his teeth, and pineth away: and I spake to thy disciples that they should cast him out; and they could not.

label: Mark 9:19
text: I answer him, and say, O faithless generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him unto me.

label: Mark 9:20
text: And they brought him unto me: and when I saw him, straightway the spirit tare him; and he fell on the ground, and wallowed foaming.

label: Mark 9:21
text: And I asked his father, How long is it ago since this came unto him? And he said, Of a child.

label: Mark 9:22
text: And ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire, and into the waters, to destroy him: but if thou canst do any thing, have compassion on us, and help us.

label: Mark 9:23
text: I said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.

label: Mark 9:24
text: And straightway the father of the child cried out, and said with tears, Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.

label: Mark 9:25
text: When I saw that the people came running together, I rebuked the foul spirit, saying unto him, Thou dumb and deaf spirit, I charge thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him.

label: Mark 9:26
text: And the spirit cried, and rent him sore, and came out of him: and he was as one dead; insomuch that many said, He is dead.

label: Mark 9:27
text: But I took him by the hand, and lifted him up; and he arose.

label: Mark 9:28
text: And when I was come into the house, my disciples asked me privately, Why could not we cast him out?

label: Mark 9:29
text: And I said unto them, This kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting.

label: Mark 9:30
text: And we departed thence, and passed through Galilee; and I would not that any man should know it.

label: Mark 9:31
text: For I taught my disciples, and said unto them, I, the Son of man, am delivered into the hands of men, and they shall kill me; and after that I am killed, I shall rise the third day.

label: Mark 9:32
text: But they understood not that saying, and were afraid to ask me.

label: Mark 9:33
text: And I came to Capernaum: and being in the house I asked them, What was it that ye disputed among yourselves by the way?

label: Mark 9:34
text: But they held their peace: for by the way they had disputed among themselves, who should be the greatest.

label: Mark 9:35
text: And I sat down, and called the twelve, and say unto them, If any man desire to be first, the same shall be last of all, and servant of all.

label: Mark 9:36
text: And I took a child, and set him in the midst of them: and when I had taken him in my arms, I said unto them,

label: Mark 9:37
text: Whosoever shall receive one of such children in my name, receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me, receiveth not me, but him that sent me.

label: Mark 9:38
text: And John answered me, saying, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name, and he followeth not us: and we forbad him, because he followeth not us.

label: Mark 9:39
text: But I said, Forbid him not: for there is no man which shall do a miracle in my name, that can lightly speak evil of me.

label: Mark 9:40
text: For he that is not against us is on our part.

label: Mark 9:41
text: For whosoever shall give you a cup of water to drink in my name, because ye belong to Christ, verily I say unto you, he shall not lose his reward.

label: Mark 9:42
text: And whosoever shall offend one of these little ones that believe in me, it is better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were cast into the sea.

label: Mark 9:43
text: And if thy hand offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter into life maimed, than having two hands to go into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:

label: Mark 9:44
text: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.

label: Mark 9:45
text: And if thy foot offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter halt into life, than having two feet to be cast into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:

label: Mark 9:46
text: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.

label: Mark 9:47
text: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out: it is better for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye, than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire:

label: Mark 9:48
text: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.

label: Mark 9:49
text: For every one shall be salted with fire, and every sacrifice shall be salted with salt.

label: Mark 9:50
text: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his saltness, wherewith will ye season it? Have salt in yourselves, and have peace one with another.

label: Mark 10:1
text: And I arose from thence, and come into the coasts of Judea by the farther side of Jordan: and the people resort unto me again; and, as I was wont, I taught them again.

label: Mark 10:2
text: And the Pharisees came to me, and asked me, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife? tempting me.

label: Mark 10:3
text: And I answered and said unto them, What did Moses command you?

label: Mark 10:4
text: And they said, Moses suffered to write a bill of divorcement, and to put her away.

label: Mark 10:5
text: And I answered and said unto them, For the hardness of your heart he wrote you this precept.

label: Mark 10:6
text: But from the beginning of the creation God made them male and female.

label: Mark 10:7
text: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and cleave to his wife;

label: Mark 10:8
text: And they twain shall be one flesh: so then they are no more twain, but one flesh.

label: Mark 10:9
text: What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.

label: Mark 10:10
text: And in the house my disciples asked me again of the same matter.

label: Mark 10:11
text: And I say unto them, Whosoever shall put away his wife, and marry another, committeth adultery against her.

label: Mark 10:12
text: And if a woman shall put away her husband, and be married to another, she committeth adultery.

label: Mark 10:13
text: And they brought young children to me, that I should touch them: and my disciples rebuked those that brought them.

label: Mark 10:14
text: But when I saw it, I was much displeased, and said unto them, Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.

label: Mark 10:15
text: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child, he shall not enter therein.

label: Mark 10:16
text: And I took them up in my arms, put my hands upon them, and blessed them.

label: Mark 10:17
text: And when I was gone forth into the way, there came one running, and kneeled to me, and asked me, Good Master, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?

label: Mark 10:18
text: And I said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God.

label: Mark 10:19
text: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Defraud not, Honour thy father and mother.

label: Mark 10:20
text: And he answered and said unto me, Master, all these have I observed from my youth.

label: Mark 10:21
text: Then I, beholding him, loved him, and said unto him, One thing thou lackest: go thy way, sell whatsoever thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, take up the cross, and follow me.

label: Mark 10:22
text: And he was sad at that saying, and went away grieved: for he had great possessions.

label: Mark 10:23
text: And I looked round about, and say unto my disciples, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!

label: Mark 10:24
text: And the disciples were astonished at my words. But I answer again, and say unto them, Children, how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of God!

label: Mark 10:25
text: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

label: Mark 10:26
text: And they were astonished out of measure, saying among themselves, Who then can be saved?

label: Mark 10:27
text: And I, looking upon them, say, With men it is impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.

label: Mark 10:28
text: Then Peter began to say unto me, Lo, we have left all, and have followed thee.

label: Mark 10:29
text: And I answered and said, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my sake, and the gospel's,

label: Mark 10:30
text: But he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time, houses, and brethren, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and lands, with persecutions; and in the world to come eternal life.

label: Mark 10:31
text: But many that are first shall be last; and the last first.

label: Mark 10:32
text: And they were in the way going up to Jerusalem; and I went before them: and they were amazed; and as they followed, they were afraid. And I took again the twelve, and began to tell them what things should happen unto me,

label: Mark 10:33
text: Saying, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and I, the Son of man, shall be delivered unto the chief priests, and unto the scribes; and they shall condemn me to death, and shall deliver me to the Gentiles:

label: Mark 10:34
text: And they shall mock me, and shall scourge me, and shall spit upon me, and shall kill me: and the third day I shall rise again.

label: Mark 10:35
text: And James and John, the sons of Zebedee, come unto me, saying, Master, we would that thou shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall desire.

label: Mark 10:36
text: And I said unto them, What would ye that I should do for you?

label: Mark 10:37
text: They said unto me, Grant unto us that we may sit, one on thy right hand, and the other on thy left hand, in thy glory.

label: Mark 10:38
text: But I said unto them, Ye know not what ye ask: can ye drink of the cup that I drink of? and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?

label: Mark 10:39
text: And they said unto me, We can. And I said unto them, Ye shall indeed drink of the cup that I drink of; and with the baptism that I am baptized withal shall ye be baptized:

label: Mark 10:40
text: But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give; but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared.

label: Mark 10:41
text: And when the ten heard it, they began to be much displeased with James and John.

label: Mark 10:42
text: But I called them to me, and say unto them, Ye know that they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and their great ones exercise authority upon them.

label: Mark 10:43
text: But so shall it not be among you: but whosoever will be great among you, shall be your minister:

label: Mark 10:44
text: And whosoever of you will be the chiefest, shall be servant of all.

label: Mark 10:45
text: For even I, the Son of man, came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give my life a ransom for many.

label: Mark 10:46
text: And we came to Jericho: and as I went out of Jericho with my disciples and a great number of people, blind Bartimeus, the son of Timeus, sat by the highway side begging.

label: Mark 10:47
text: And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out, and say, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.

label: Mark 10:48
text: And many charged him that he should hold his peace: but he cried the more a great deal, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.

label: Mark 10:49
text: And I stood still, and commanded him to be called. And they call the blind man, saying unto him, Be of good comfort, rise; he calleth thee.

label: Mark 10:50
text: And he, casting away his garment, rose, and came to me.

label: Mark 10:51
text: And I answered and said unto him, What wilt thou that I should do unto thee? The blind man said unto me, Lord, that I might receive my sight.

label: Mark 10:52
text: And I said unto him, Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole. And immediately he received his sight, and followed me in the way.

label: Mark 11:1
text: And when we came nigh to Jerusalem, unto Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount of Olives, I send forth two of my disciples,

label: Mark 11:2
text: And say unto them, Go your way into the village over against you: and as soon as ye be entered into it, ye shall find a colt tied, whereon never man sat; loose him, and bring him.

label: Mark 11:3
text: And if any man say unto you, Why do ye this? say ye that the Lord hath need of him; and straightway he will send him hither.

label: Mark 11:4
text: And they went their way, and found the colt tied by the door without in a place where two ways met; and they loose him.

label: Mark 11:5
text: And certain of them that stood there said unto them, What do ye, loosing the colt?

label: Mark 11:6
text: And they said unto them even as I had commanded: and they let them go.

label: Mark 11:7
text: And they brought the colt to me, and cast their garments on him; and I sat upon him.

label: Mark 11:8
text: And many spread their garments in the way: and others cut down branches off the trees, and strawed them in the way.

label: Mark 11:9
text: And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna; Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord:

label: Mark 11:10
text: Blessed be the kingdom of our father David, that cometh in the name of the Lord: Hosanna in the highest.

label: Mark 11:11
text: And I entered into Jerusalem, and into the temple: and when I had looked round about upon all things, and now the eventide was come, I went out unto Bethany with the twelve.

label: Mark 11:12
text: And on the morrow, when we were come from Bethany, I was hungry:

label: Mark 11:13
text: And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, I came, if haply I might find any thing thereon: and when I came to it, I found nothing but leaves; for the time of figs was not yet.

label: Mark 11:14
text: And I answered and said unto it, No man eat fruit of thee hereafter for ever. And my disciples heard it.

label: Mark 11:15
text: And we come to Jerusalem: and I went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves;

label: Mark 11:16
text: And would not suffer that any man should carry any vessel through the temple.

label: Mark 11:17
text: And I taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of thieves.

label: Mark 11:18
text: And the scribes and chief priests heard it, and sought how they might destroy me: for they feared me, because all the people was astonished at my doctrine.

label: Mark 11:19
text: And when even was come, I went out of the city.

label: Mark 11:20
text: And in the morning, as we passed by, we saw the fig tree dried up from the roots.

label: Mark 11:21
text: And Peter calling to remembrance saith unto me, Master, behold, the fig tree which thou cursedst is withered away.

label: Mark 11:22
text: And I, answering, say unto them, Have faith in God.

label: Mark 11:23
text: For verily I say unto you, That whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass; he shall have whatsoever he saith.

label: Mark 11:24
text: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.

label: Mark 11:25
text: And when ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have ought against any: that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.

label: Mark 11:26
text: But if ye do not forgive, neither will your Father which is in heaven forgive your trespasses.

label: Mark 11:27
text: And we come again to Jerusalem: and as I was walking in the temple, there come to me the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders,

label: Mark 11:28
text: And say unto me, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority to do these things?

label: Mark 11:29
text: And I answered and said unto them, I will also ask of you one question, and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.

label: Mark 11:30
text: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men? answer me.

label: Mark 11:31
text: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then did ye not believe him?

label: Mark 11:32
text: But if we shall say, Of men; they feared the people: for all men counted John, that he was a prophet indeed.

label: Mark 11:33
text: And they answered and said unto me, We cannot tell. And I, answering, say unto them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.

label: Mark 12:1
text: And I began to speak unto them by parables. A certain man planted a vineyard, and set an hedge about it, and digged a place for the winefat, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country.

label: Mark 12:2
text: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard.

label: Mark 12:3
text: And they caught him, and beat him, and sent him away empty.

label: Mark 12:4
text: And again he sent unto them another servant; and at him they cast stones, and wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully handled.

label: Mark 12:5
text: And again he sent another; and him they killed, and many others; beating some, and killing some.

label: Mark 12:6
text: Having yet therefore one son, his wellbeloved, he sent him also last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.

label: Mark 12:7
text: But those husbandmen said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be ours.

label: Mark 12:8
text: And they took him, and killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.

label: Mark 12:9
text: What shall therefore the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others.

label: Mark 12:10
text: And have ye not read this scripture; The stone which the builders rejected is become the head of the corner:

label: Mark 12:11
text: This was the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?

label: Mark 12:12
text: And they sought to lay hold on me, but feared the people: for they knew that I had spoken the parable against them: and they left me, and went their way.

label: Mark 12:13
text: And they send unto me certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, to catch me in my words.

label: Mark 12:14
text: And when they were come, they say unto me, Master, we know that thou art true, and carest for no man: for thou regardest not the person of men, but teachest the way of God in truth: Is it lawful to give tribute to Cesar, or not?

label: Mark 12:15
text: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But I, knowing their hypocrisy, said unto them, Why tempt ye me? bring me a penny, that I may see it.

label: Mark 12:16
text: And they brought it. And I say unto them, Whose is this image and superscription? And they said unto me, Cesar's.

label: Mark 12:17
text: And I, answering, said unto them, Render to Cesar the things that are Cesar's, and to God the things that are God's. And they marvelled at me.

label: Mark 12:18
text: Then come unto me the Sadducees, which say there is no resurrection; and they asked me, saying,

label: Mark 12:19
text: Master, Moses wrote unto us, If a man's brother die, and leave his wife behind him, and leave no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

label: Mark 12:20
text: Now there were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed.

label: Mark 12:21
text: And the second took her, and died, neither left he any seed: and the third likewise.

label: Mark 12:22
text: And the seven had her, and left no seed: last of all the woman died also.

label: Mark 12:23
text: In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.

label: Mark 12:24
text: And I, answering, said unto them, Do ye not therefore err, because ye know not the scriptures, neither the power of God?

label: Mark 12:25
text: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as the angels which are in heaven.

label: Mark 12:26
text: And as touching the dead, that they rise: have ye not read in the book of Moses, how in the bush God spake unto him, saying, I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?

label: Mark 12:27
text: He is not the God of the dead, but the God of the living: ye therefore do greatly err.

label: Mark 12:28
text: And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that I had answered them well, asked me, Which is the first commandment of all?

label: Mark 12:29
text: And I answered him, The first of all the commandments is, Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord:

label: Mark 12:30
text: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.

label: Mark 12:31
text: And the second is like, namely this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.

label: Mark 12:32
text: And the scribe said unto me, Well, Master, thou hast said the truth: for there is one God; and there is none other but he:

label: Mark 12:33
text: And to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbour as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.

label: Mark 12:34
text: And when I saw that he answered discreetly, I said unto him, Thou art not far from the kingdom of God. And no man after that durst ask me any question.

label: Mark 12:35
text: And I answered and said, while I taught in the temple, How say the scribes that Christ is the Son of David?

label: Mark 12:36
text: For David himself said by the Holy Ghost, The Lord said to my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool.

label: Mark 12:37
text: David therefore himself calleth him Lord; and whence is he then his son? And the common people heard me gladly.

label: Mark 12:38
text: And I said unto them in my doctrine, Beware of the scribes, which love to go in long clothing, and love salutations in the marketplaces,

label: Mark 12:39
text: And the chief seats in the synagogues, and the uppermost rooms at feasts:

label: Mark 12:40
text: Which devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater damnation.

label: Mark 12:41
text: And I sat over against the treasury, and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.

label: Mark 12:42
text: And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing.

label: Mark 12:43
text: And I called unto me my disciples, and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:

label: Mark 12:44
text: For all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.

label: Mark 13:1
text: And as I went out of the temple, one of my disciples saith unto me, Master, see what manner of stones and what buildings are here!

label: Mark 13:2
text: And I, answering, said unto him, Seest thou these great buildings? there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

label: Mark 13:3
text: And as I sat upon the mount of Olives over against the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked me privately,

label: Mark 13:4
text: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?

label: Mark 13:5
text: And I, answering them, began to say, Take heed lest any man deceive you:

label: Mark 13:6
text: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.

label: Mark 13:7
text: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be ye not troubled: for such things must needs be; but the end shall not be yet.

label: Mark 13:8
text: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these are the beginnings of sorrows.

label: Mark 13:9
text: But take heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to councils; and in the synagogues ye shall be beaten: and ye shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them.

label: Mark 13:10
text: And the gospel must first be published among all nations.

label: Mark 13:11
text: But when they shall lead you, and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak, neither do ye premeditate: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye: for it is not ye that speak, but the Holy Ghost.

label: Mark 13:12
text: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death, and the father the son; and children shall rise up against their parents, and shall cause them to be put to death.

label: Mark 13:13
text: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.

label: Mark 13:14
text: But when ye shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (let him that readeth understand,) then let them that be in Judea flee to the mountains:

label: Mark 13:15
text: And let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house, neither enter therein, to take any thing out of his house:

label: Mark 13:16
text: And let him that is in the field not turn back again for to take up his garment.

label: Mark 13:17
text: But woe to them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!

label: Mark 13:18
text: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter.

label: Mark 13:19
text: For in those days shall be affliction, such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time, neither shall be.

label: Mark 13:20
text: And except that the Lord had shortened those days, no flesh should be saved: but for the elect's sake, whom he hath chosen, he hath shortened the days.

label: Mark 13:21
text: And then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here is Christ; or, lo, he is there; believe him not:

label: Mark 13:22
text: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.

label: Mark 13:23
text: But take ye heed: behold, I have foretold you all things.

label: Mark 13:24
text: But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,

label: Mark 13:25
text: And the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken.

label: Mark 13:26
text: And then shall they see me, the Son of man, coming in the clouds with great power and glory.

label: Mark 13:27
text: And then shall I send my angels, and shall gather together my elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.

label: Mark 13:28
text: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When her branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is near:

label: Mark 13:29
text: So ye in like manner, when ye shall see these things come to pass, know that it is nigh, even at the doors.

label: Mark 13:30
text: Verily I say unto you, that this generation shall not pass, till all these things be done.

label: Mark 13:31
text: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.

label: Mark 13:32
text: But of that day and that hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither I, the Son, but my Father.

label: Mark 13:33
text: Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.

label: Mark 13:34
text: For the Son of man is as a man taking a far journey, who left his house, and gave authority to his servants, and to every man his work, and commanded the porter to watch.

label: Mark 13:35
text: Watch ye therefore: for ye know not when the master of the house cometh, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning:

label: Mark 13:36
text: Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping.

label: Mark 13:37
text: And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.

label: Mark 14:1
text: After two days was the feast of the passover, and of unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take me by craft, and put me to death.

label: Mark 14:2
text: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar of the people.

label: Mark 14:3
text: And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as I sat at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of spikenard very precious; and she brake the box, and poured it on my head.

label: Mark 14:4
text: And there were some that had indignation within themselves, and said, Why was this waste of the ointment made?

label: Mark 14:5
text: For it might have been sold for more than three hundred pence, and have been given to the poor. And they murmured against her.

label: Mark 14:6
text: And I said, Let her alone; why trouble ye her? she hath wrought a good work on me.

label: Mark 14:7
text: For ye have the poor with you always, and whensoever ye will ye may do them good: but me ye have not always.

label: Mark 14:8
text: She hath done what she could: she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying.

label: Mark 14:9
text: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world, this also that she hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.

label: Mark 14:10
text: And Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went unto the chief priests, to betray me unto them.

label: Mark 14:11
text: And when they heard it, they were glad, and promised to give him money. And he sought how he might conveniently betray me.

label: Mark 14:12
text: And the first day of unleavened bread, when they killed the passover, my disciples said unto me, Where wilt thou that we go and prepare that thou mayest eat the passover?

label: Mark 14:13
text: And I send forth two of my disciples, and say unto them, Go ye into the city, and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water: follow him.

label: Mark 14:14
text: And wheresoever he shall go in, say ye to the goodman of the house, The Master saith, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?

label: Mark 14:15
text: And he will shew you a large upper room furnished and prepared: there make ready for us.

label: Mark 14:16
text: And my disciples went forth, and came into the city, and found as I had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.

label: Mark 14:17
text: And in the evening I come with the twelve.

label: Mark 14:18
text: And as we sat and did eat, I said, Verily I say unto you, One of you which eateth with me shall betray me.

label: Mark 14:19
text: And they began to be sorrowful, and to say unto me one by one, Is it I? and another said, Is it I?

label: Mark 14:20
text: And I answered and said unto them, It is one of the twelve, that dippeth with me in the dish.

label: Mark 14:21
text: I, the Son of man, indeed go, as it is written of me: but woe to that man by whom I, the Son of man, am betrayed! good were it for that man if he had never been born.

label: Mark 14:22
text: And as we did eat, I took bread, and blessed, and brake it, and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.

label: Mark 14:23
text: And I took the cup, and when I had given thanks, I gave it to them: and they all drank of it.

label: Mark 14:24
text: And I said unto them, This is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many.

label: Mark 14:25
text: Verily I say unto you, I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine, until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of God.

label: Mark 14:26
text: And when we had sung an hymn, we went out into the mount of Olives.

label: Mark 14:27
text: And I say unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered.

label: Mark 14:28
text: But after that I am risen, I will go before you into Galilee.

label: Mark 14:29
text: But Peter said unto me, Although all shall be offended, yet will not I.

label: Mark 14:30
