text: And I say unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this day, even in this night, before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice.

label: Mark 14:31
text: But he spake the more vehemently, If I should die with thee, I will not deny thee in any wise. Likewise also said they all.

label: Mark 14:32
text: And we came to a place which was named Gethsemane: and I say to my disciples, Sit ye here, while I shall pray.

label: Mark 14:33
text: And I take with me Peter and James and John, and began to be sore amazed, and to be very heavy;

label: Mark 14:34
text: And say unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death: tarry ye here, and watch.

label: Mark 14:35
text: And I went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from me.

label: Mark 14:36
text: And I said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.

label: Mark 14:37
text: And I come, and find them sleeping, and say unto Peter, Simon, sleepest thou? couldest not thou watch one hour?

label: Mark 14:38
text: Watch ye and pray, lest ye enter into temptation. The spirit truly is ready, but the flesh is weak.

label: Mark 14:39
text: And again I went away, and prayed, and spake the same words.

label: Mark 14:40
text: And when I returned, I found them asleep again, (for their eyes were heavy,) neither wist they what to answer me.

label: Mark 14:41
text: And I come the third time, and say unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: it is enough, the hour is come; behold, I, the Son of man, am betrayed into the hands of sinners.

label: Mark 14:42
text: Rise up, let us go; lo, he that betrayeth me is at hand.

label: Mark 14:43
text: And immediately, while I yet spake, cometh Judas, one of the twelve, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.

label: Mark 14:44
text: And he that betrayed me had given them a token, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he; take him, and lead him away safely.

label: Mark 14:45
text: And as soon as he was come, he goeth straightway to me, and saith, Master, master; and kissed me.

label: Mark 14:46
text: And they laid their hands on me, and took me.

label: Mark 14:47
text: And one of them that stood by drew a sword, and smote a servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

label: Mark 14:48
text: And I answered and said unto them, Are ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and with staves to take me?

label: Mark 14:49
text: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and ye took me not: but the scriptures must be fulfilled.

label: Mark 14:50
text: And they all forsook me, and fled.

label: Mark 14:51
text: And there followed me a certain young man, having a linen cloth cast about his naked body; and the young men laid hold on him:

label: Mark 14:52
text: And he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.

label: Mark 14:53
text: And they led me away to the high priest: and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.

label: Mark 14:54
text: And Peter followed me afar off, even into the palace of the high priest: and he sat with the servants, and warmed himself at the fire.

label: Mark 14:55
text: And the chief priests and all the council sought for witness against me to put me to death; and found none.

label: Mark 14:56
text: For many bare false witness against me, but their witness agreed not together.

label: Mark 14:57
text: And there arose certain, and bare false witness against me, saying,

label: Mark 14:58
text: We heard him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.

label: Mark 14:59
text: But neither so did their witness agree together.

label: Mark 14:60
text: And the high priest stood up in the midst, and asked me, saying, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?

label: Mark 14:61
text: But I held my peace, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked me, and said unto me, Art thou the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?

label: Mark 14:62
text: And I said, I am: and ye shall see me, the Son of man, sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.

label: Mark 14:63
text: Then the high priest rent his clothes, and saith, What need we any further witnesses?

label: Mark 14:64
text: Ye have heard the blasphemy: what think ye? And they all condemned me to be guilty of death.

label: Mark 14:65
text: And some began to spit on me, and to cover my face, and to buffet me, and to say unto me, Prophesy: and the servants did strike me with the palms of their hands.

label: Mark 14:66
text: And as Peter was beneath in the palace, there cometh one of the maids of the high priest:

label: Mark 14:67
text: And when she saw Peter warming himself, she looked upon him, and said, And thou also wast with Jesus of Nazareth.

label: Mark 14:68
text: But he denied, saying, I know not, neither understand I what thou sayest. And he went out into the porch; and the cock crew.

label: Mark 14:69
text: And a maid saw him again, and began to say to them that stood by, This is one of them.

label: Mark 14:70
text: And he denied it again. And a little after, they that stood by said again to Peter, Surely thou art one of them: for thou art a Galilean, and thy speech agreeth thereto.

label: Mark 14:71
text: But he began to curse and to swear, saying, I know not this man of whom ye speak.

label: Mark 14:72
text: And the second time the cock crew. And Peter called to mind the word that I said unto him, Before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice. And when he thought thereon, he wept.

label: Mark 15:1
text: And straightway in the morning the chief priests held a consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council, and bound me, and carried me away, and delivered me to Pilate.

label: Mark 15:2
text: And Pilate asked me, Art thou the King of the Jews? And I, answering, said unto him, Thou sayest it.

label: Mark 15:3
text: And the chief priests accused me of many things: but I answered nothing.

label: Mark 15:4
text: And Pilate asked me again, saying, Answerest thou nothing? behold how many things they witness against thee.

label: Mark 15:5
text: But I yet answered nothing; so that Pilate marvelled.

label: Mark 15:6
text: Now at that feast he released unto them one prisoner, whomsoever they desired.

label: Mark 15:7
text: And there was one named Barabbas, which lay bound with them that had made insurrection with him, who had committed murder in the insurrection.

label: Mark 15:8
text: And the multitude crying aloud began to desire him to do as he had ever done unto them.

label: Mark 15:9
text: But Pilate answered them, saying, Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews?

label: Mark 15:10
text: For he knew that the chief priests had delivered me for envy.

label: Mark 15:11
text: But the chief priests moved the people, that he should rather release Barabbas unto them.

label: Mark 15:12
text: And Pilate answered and said again unto them, What will ye then that I shall do unto him whom ye call the King of the Jews?

label: Mark 15:13
text: And they cried out again, Crucify him.

label: Mark 15:14
text: Then Pilate said unto them, Why, what evil hath he done? And they cried out the more exceedingly, Crucify him.

label: Mark 15:15
text: And so Pilate, willing to content the people, released Barabbas unto them, and delivered me, when he had scourged me, to be crucified.

label: Mark 15:16
text: And the soldiers led me away into the hall, called Pretorium; and they call together the whole band.

label: Mark 15:17
text: And they clothed me with purple, and platted a crown of thorns, and put it about my head,

label: Mark 15:18
text: And began to salute me, Hail, King of the Jews!

label: Mark 15:19
text: And they smote me on the head with a reed, and did spit upon me, and bowing their knees worshipped me.

label: Mark 15:20
text: And when they had mocked me, they took off the purple from me, and put my own clothes on me, and led me out to crucify me.

label: Mark 15:21
text: And they compel one Simon a Cyrenian, who passed by, coming out of the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to bear my cross.

label: Mark 15:22
text: And they bring me unto the place Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, The place of a skull.

label: Mark 15:23
text: And they gave me to drink wine mingled with myrrh: but I received it not.

label: Mark 15:24
text: And when they had crucified me, they parted my garments, casting lots upon them, what every man should take.

label: Mark 15:25
text: And it was the third hour, and they crucified me.

label: Mark 15:26
text: And the superscription of my accusation was written over, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

label: Mark 15:27
text: And with me they crucify two thieves; the one on my right hand, and the other on my left.

label: Mark 15:28
text: And the scripture was fulfilled, which saith, And he was numbered with the transgressors.

label: Mark 15:29
text: And they that passed by railed on me, wagging their heads, and saying, Ah, thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days,

label: Mark 15:30
text: Save thyself, and come down from the cross.

label: Mark 15:31
text: Likewise also the chief priests mocking said among themselves with the scribes, He saved others; himself he cannot save.

label: Mark 15:32
text: Let Christ the King of Israel descend now from the cross, that we may see and believe. And they that were crucified with me reviled me.

label: Mark 15:33
text: And when the sixth hour was come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.

label: Mark 15:34
text: And at the ninth hour I cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?

label: Mark 15:35
text: And some of them that stood by, when they heard it, said, Behold, he calleth Elias.

label: Mark 15:36
text: And one ran and filled a spunge full of vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave me to drink, saying, Let alone; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down.

label: Mark 15:37
text: And I cried with a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.

label: Mark 15:38
text: And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom.

label: Mark 15:39
text: And when the centurion, which stood over against me, saw that I so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.

label: Mark 15:40
text: There were also women looking on afar off: among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;

label: Mark 15:41
text: (Who also, when I was in Galilee, followed me, and ministered unto me;) and many other women which came up with me unto Jerusalem.

label: Mark 15:42
text: And now when the even was come, because it was the preparation, that is, the day before the sabbath,

label: Mark 15:43
text: Joseph of Arimathea, an honourable counsellor, which also waited for the kingdom of God, came, and went in boldly unto Pilate, and craved my body.

label: Mark 15:44
text: And Pilate marvelled if I were already dead: and calling unto him the centurion, he asked him whether I had been any while dead.

label: Mark 15:45
text: And when he knew it of the centurion, he gave my body to Joseph.

label: Mark 15:46
text: And he bought fine linen, and took me down, and wrapped me in the linen, and laid me in a sepulchre which was hewn out of a rock, and rolled a stone unto the door of the sepulchre.

label: Mark 15:47
text: And Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses beheld where I was laid.

label: Mark 16:1
text: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, had bought sweet spices, that they might come and anoint me.

label: Mark 16:2
text: And very early in the morning the first day of the week, they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun.

label: Mark 16:3
text: And they said among themselves, Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the sepulchre?

label: Mark 16:4
text: And when they looked, they saw that the stone was rolled away: for it was very great.

label: Mark 16:5
text: And entering into the sepulchre, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, clothed in a long white garment; and they were affrighted.

label: Mark 16:6
text: And he saith unto them, Be not affrighted: Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, which was crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold the place where they laid him.

label: Mark 16:7
text: But go your way, tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said unto you.

label: Mark 16:8
text: And they went out quickly, and fled from the sepulchre; for they trembled and were amazed: neither said they any thing to any man; for they were afraid.

label: Mark 16:9
text: Now when I was risen early the first day of the week, I appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom I had cast seven devils.

label: Mark 16:10
text: And she went and told them that had been with me, as they mourned and wept.

label: Mark 16:11
text: And they, when they had heard that I was alive, and had been seen of her, believed not.

label: Mark 16:12
text: After that I appeared in another form unto two of them, as they walked, and went into the country.

label: Mark 16:13
text: And they went and told it unto the residue: neither believed they them.

label: Mark 16:14
text: Afterward I appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat, and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them which had seen me after I was risen.

label: Mark 16:15
text: And I said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.

label: Mark 16:16
text: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that believeth not shall be damned.

label: Mark 16:17
text: And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out devils; they shall speak with new tongues;

label: Mark 16:18
text: They shall take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall not hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover.

label: Mark 16:19
text: So then after I had spoken unto them, I was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of God.

label: Mark 16:20
text: And they went forth, and preached every where, I working with them, and confirming the word with signs following. Amen.
